requirements.title: Project corrections v2 compatibility
requirements.description: Select structured corrections progressively while preserving v1 history and fail-safe version movement.
requirements.fullText: A v2 correction preserves the exact six historical v1 fields and v1 identity, adds a separate whole-v2 identity, and may reference only released registered checks. Keep v1 full-read compatibility. Unknown absorption retains the correction; non-empty v2 blocks adoption by an incompatible version unless a separately reviewed atomic reverse migration exists.
